title: puck/lora_l2: radio-path liveness signal for the watchdog (design decision)
description: Follow-up from cdoj (docs landed this round). After sb0b's async RX, nothing bumps lichen_radio_progress() during idle-armed silence, so the puck watchdog no longer guards radio-path liveness — only main-thread lockups. Two candidate designs if radio-path liveness monitoring is wanted: (a) a low-rate keepalive work item while armed-and-idle (careful: reintroduces the polling the 9hfe epic removed), or (b) source the heartbeat from driver IRQ/progress counters (e.g. the loopback/sx126x drivers exposing arm/delivery counters read by the app). Needs a design call plus puck WDT comment/constant updates. Also noted as pre-existing shape: a hung lora_send() (SPI fault) holds modem_mutex indefinitely and masks stalls from the watchdog.
